description: Provides platform-agnostic web development knowledge covering functional correctness, accessibility, SEO, security, performance, privacy, resilience, and standards compliance.
Provides Nuxt-specific knowledge covering application structure, Vue integration, routing, rendering, hydration, data fetching, state, Nitro APIs, deployment, type safety, and testing.
Provides structured methods for turning an ambiguous idea into a bounded, testable, decision-ready product concept with explicit scope, appetite, risks, validation needs, and success criteria.
Provides methods for identifying, testing, and expressing customer problems, affected users, current alternatives, context, severity, frequency, and supporting evidence.
Provides structured identification, classification, prioritisation, and treatment of product, technical, operational, commercial, legal, security, privacy, delivery, and adoption risks.
Provides cross-cutting resilience knowledge covering failure handling, retries, idempotency, degradation, recovery, observability, rollback, dependency failure, and state integrity.
Provides methods for converting an approved idea or specification into small, ordered, independently reviewable implementation tasks with explicit dependencies, context, and commit outcomes.
Provides methods for writing and validating concrete, observable, testable acceptance criteria covering successful behaviour, boundaries, failure states, and completion.
